# BB00153: Ziyarat for the two hidden names {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Unapproachable, the Most Holy!

The splendor of God rest upon you both, O ye two luminous lights, ye two blazing flames, ye two exalted names, ye two impregnable words, ye two celestial fruits, ye two concealed countenances! And upon you be glory, and beauty from your right hand, and grandeur from your left hand, and light before you, and mercy behind you, and might above your heads, and bounty beneath your feet.

God hath never ceased to send down upon you both from every splendor its most splendid, from every glory its most glorious, from every beauty its most beautiful, from every grandeur its most grand, from every light its most luminous, from every mercy its most extensive, from all words their most perfect, from every might its mightiest, from all names their greatest, from every will its most effective, from every knowledge its most penetrating, from every power its most potent, from every utterance its most pleasing, from all questions their most beloved, from every dominion its most enduring, from every sovereignty its most excellent, from every loftiness its most sublime, from every bounty that which hath no equal, and from every good that which hath no parallel.

Ye have ascended unto God, your Lord, even as ye began with God, your Lord. God hath never ceased to gaze upon you and to send down His mercy upon whosoever remembereth you and grieveth for you and weepeth for that which was decreed for you in the path of God.

And verily, upon you and upon whosoever hath ascended unto God, your Lord, be that which befitteth the sublimity of God's grace and His bounty, and the exaltation of His generosity and munificence. Verily, He is the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.
